title: Brad Pitt's Cliff Booth returns as David Fincher's sequel premieres in Los Angeles
summary: The Netflix film, written by Quentin Tarantino, opens in IMAX cinemas on 25 November.
body:
The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, the follow-up to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood, had its premiere in Los Angeles on Monday 16 November.

Brad Pitt reprises his Oscar-winning role as the stuntman Cliff Booth. The film was directed by David Fincher from a script by Quentin Tarantino, and is set in 1977.

When to see it

Netflix will show it exclusively in IMAX cinemas from 25 November before it begins streaming on 23 December.

Only brief social media reactions were allowed after the premiere. Full reviews are under embargo until 19 November.

Sources: Variety, Yahoo Entertainment, TV Insider.
